units.source_text: 产后六日，明石女御从西北院迁回东南院。

en.t: Six days after the birth, the Akashi Consort moved back from the northwest residence to the southeast residence.

units.source_text: 第七日之夜，冷泉帝也赐赠贺仪。

en.t: On the night of the seventh day, Emperor Reizei also sent gifts of congratulation.

units.source_text: 朱雀院已经出家，不能亲来探视，特派头弁为代表，

en.t: Suzaku-in had already taken Buddhist vows and could not come to visit in person, so he specially sent To no Ben as his representative,

units.source_text: 奉旨向藏人所取出种种珍宝，赐赠女御。

en.t: and by imperial command various precious treasures were brought out from the Chamberlain's Office and presented to the Consort.

units.source_text: 犒赏诸人的衣服，由秋好皇后调度，比朝廷所置办的更为体面。

en.t: The robes given as rewards to the attendants were arranged by Empress Akikonomu and were even more splendid than those prepared by the court.

units.source_text: 其次诸亲王、诸大臣，家家户户都为送礼而奔忙，大家力求尽善尽美。

en.t: After that, the princes and ministers, each household in turn, bustled about preparing gifts, and everyone strove to make them perfect.

units.source_text: 源氏一向崇尚简约，但为此事破例，贺仪隆重无比，举世盛称。

en.t: Genji had always valued simplicity, but for this occasion he made an exception; the celebrations were extraordinarily grand and were praised throughout the world.

units.source_text: 其潜心设计的优雅精致之趣，应有记载传之后世。

en.t: The graceful and exquisite effects he had designed with such care deserve to be recorded and handed down to later generations.

units.source_text: 但因笔者未曾一一亲睹，故不详述。

en.t: But since the writer did not personally see every detail, I will not describe them at length.
